data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md` covering: schema_version=1, all 11 common fields (schema_version, event_id, event_type, client_id, tool_id, tool_version, timestamp, pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language), all 5 event types (review_finding, resolver_outcome, arbiter_ruling, tool_finding, review_cycle) with per-type fields and defaults, the two-layer privacy policy, and a clearly-labeled Privacy Disclosure section.
**Why**: Contract-first work — both the Lambda handler and emit utility consume this document. Drafting it early lets later stories reference a canonical source.
**Scope**:
- IN: The contract document itself, covering all schema fields, event types, privacy policy, and Privacy Disclosure section.
- OUT: Code implementations (handler, emit utility, query-stats — those are separate stories).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md` exists with sections documenting schema_version=1, all 11 common fields, all 5 event types with per-type fields and defaults, the two-layer privacy policy, and a clearly-labeled Privacy Disclosure section.
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "canonical event schema documented at telemetry-event-schema.md with all 5 event types, schema_version=1, all 11 common fields, Privacy Disclosure section")
- When this story is complete, each of the 5 event types includes a complete worked example showing all common and per-type fields populated.
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, the Privacy Disclosure section explicitly states that setting `telemetry.emit_excerpts=true` causes verbatim code from `cited_excerpt` to be readable by the central-endpoint maintainer.
  ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Contract stability] schema_version=1 is load-bearing; document the version-bump policy for future breaking changes.
- [Cross-reference] Link to this contract from telemetry-emit.sh and Lambda handler comments so future maintainers find the source of truth.
- [Cross-document consistency] If any of the 5 event types embeds reviewer-finding payload shape, ensure rule_id (added by the reviewer-base.md story) is reflected here as an optional per-type field.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a downstream consumer, I want the canonical telemetry event schema documented at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md, so that every emitter and consumer can validate events against a single contract.
